redwine.name: Bottle of Red Wine
redwine.note: One vendor, one turn-in NPC, one zone. The single simplest unlock in the game. Requires indifferent standing.
redwine.gain_raw: Dreadguard Inner +5 · Dreadguard Outer +5 · Dark Bargainers +10

muffins.name: Muffin for Pandos
muffins.note: Feeds Wood Elf and High Elf at the same time. If you are KoS, trade him from the next room through the open door in third person.
muffins.gain_raw: Clerics of Tunare +5 · Soldiers of Tunare +5 · Faydark Champions +5 · King Tearis Thex +5

whitewine.name: Hogcaller's Inn, first step
whitewine.item: White Wine (Swin Blackeye or Drona Whystlethin)
whitewine.note: Same building as Pandos. Lady Shae sits on a unique faction that is neutral to everyone, so nobody is locked out.
whitewine.gain_raw: Emerald Warriors +5 · Merchants of Felwithe +5 · Merchants of Kelethin +5

batwings.name: Bat Wings
batwings.note: Four wings per turn-in, so 1600 wings is 400 cycles. Needs at least indifferent with her.
batwings.gain_raw: Keepers of the Art +5 · King Tearis Thex +5 · Faydark Champions +5 — per 4 wings

brandy.name: Rohand's Brandy
brandy.note: +25 a hit on Merchants of Qeynos is one of the largest per-turn-in gains available anywhere. Also feeds Human (Freeport).
brandy.gain_raw: Merchants of Qeynos +25 · Antonius Bayle +5 · Coalition of Tradefolk +5 · Guards of Qeynos +5

mead.name: Honey Mead for Trumpy
mead.note: Trades guards and merchants away for corrupt guards, but Legends' +5 minimum gain makes it come out ahead. Four mead per cycle.
mead.gain_raw: Corrupt Qeynos Guards +5 · Circle of Unseen Hands +5 · Kane Bayle +5 — per 4 mead

tonics400.name: Tumpy Tonics
tonics400.item: 800 Kiola Nut + 1600 Flask of Water, brewed
tonics400.note: Brew them rather than handing Tumpy Irontoe 1 nut and 2 waters 800 times. Budget about 843 nuts and 1686 water for failures at trivial.
tonics400.gain_raw: Storm Guard +5 · Kazon Stormhammer +5 · Merchants of Kaladim +5 · Miners Guild 249 +5

tonics110.name: Tonics for Groflah
tonics110.item: 110 Kiola Nut + 220 Flask of Water, brewed
tonics110.note: He spawns at the dock bar at night and shares a spawn with other NPCs — hop difficulties to reroll the spawn. Only 100 are strictly needed; the extra 10 buffers your Knights of Truth for the next step.
tonics110.gain_raw: Coalition of Tradefolk +10 · Coalition Underground +10 · Knights of Truth +10 · Merchants of Qeynos +7

intercept.name: Message Intercept
intercept.npc: Mojax Hikspin, then Sir Lucan D`Lere
intercept.note: Give Mojax milk to spawn Duggin Scumber, kill him for a note, repeat 42 times, then hand every note to Sir Lucan. Hail Mojax repeatedly to stop him wandering. Buy 100+ milk; this step is fiddly.
intercept.gain_raw: Freeport Militia +25 · Coalition Underground +5 — per note

boxes.name: Series C Black Boxes, first part
boxes.npc: Manik Compolten, then any Series C clockwork
boxes.item: Shiny Cards — free from the quest NPC
boxes.note: Costs nothing but clicks. Fill your bags with cards, trade them for black boxes, destroy the boxes, repeat. Needs amiable with Gem Choppers to start — Shondo and the Tonic is the fastest way there.
boxes.gain_raw: King Ak'Anon +5 · Eldritch Collective +5 · Gem Choppers +5

lionmeat.name: Lion Meat Shipment
lionmeat.note: Four shipments per turn-in. Bind in front of Teria and gate. Wizard at 23 for West Karana Gate plus Lesser Evacuate cuts the run down enormously; this step is mostly travel.
lionmeat.gain_raw: Merchants of Halas +10 · Wolves of the North +7 · Shamen of Justice +7 · Rogues of the White Rose +5

iceberg.name: Lion Delights to Iceberg
iceberg.item: 200 Lion Delight from the step above
iceberg.note: He despawns the moment you hand him one, so trade the entire batch in a single window. Keep the Delights below your normal food so you do not eat them.
iceberg.gain_raw: Wolves of the North +5 · Shamen of Justice +5 · Merchants of Halas +5 · Steel Warriors +5 · Rogues of the White Rose +5

phosph.name: Phosphorous Powder
phosph.zone: Ruins of Old Guk → Rathe Mountains
phosph.note: Dar, zol and bok ghoul knights each drop two at close to 100%. Roughly 400–500 kills. This is the one grind that pays you back — expect to take two classes to 50 while doing it.
phosph.gain_raw: Guktan Suppliers +5 · Protectors of Gukta +5 · Guktan Elders +5 · High Council of Gukta +5 · Lorekeepers of Gukta +5 — per 2 powder

iksarore.name: High Quality Ore to Iktra
iksarore.item: 160 Metal Bits, then 180 Small Piece of High Quality Ore
iksarore.note: Only one faction to max, but the raw plat runs over 1600. Start with Metal Bits — they stop working at amiable but they are cheap. Cut fine steel weapons into bricks or farm Runnyeye goblins to bring the cost down.
iksarore.gain_raw: New Sebilisian Expedition +5 for 4 Metal Bits · +10 per Small Piece of High Quality Ore

kobolds.name: Kill 400 kobolds
kobolds.note: Do not turn in the molars for Heretics faction — they cost you Deepwater Knights. Kobold kills here also feed Kerra Isle faction, which was added recently.
kobolds.gain_raw: Heretics +5 · High Guard of Erudin +5 · Clan Kobolk −1

molars.name: Kobold Molars (Good)
molars.item: Kobold Molars from the kills above
molars.note: 286 molars maxes Deepwater Knights on its own but needs roughly 1430 kobold kills to gather. Mix it with killing Paineel guards rather than relying on it alone.
molars.gain_raw: Deepwater Knights +7 · High Council of Erudin +5 · Heretics −1

paineel.name: Kill Paineel heretics
paineel.note: Atdehim Sqonci gives +100, capped by patch, and is still the fastest single target. Eight named guards give +25 each; ordinary guards give +10. Open a personal instance and work through them.
paineel.gain_raw: Deepwater Knights +10 to +100 per kill · Heretics −10 to −100

catman.name: Catman Alliance
catman.item: Rolled Up Strip of Cloth — free from the prisoner
catman.note: Run it until amiable with Peace Keepers to open the Peacekeeper Staff quest, or all the way to +2000 if you would rather travel than destroy items. Ring of Toxxulia at Druid 17 skips most of the run.
catman.gain_raw: Peace Keepers +5 · High Council of Erudin +5 · Heretics −1

peacekeeper.name: Peacekeeper Staff, first step
peacekeeper.item: Sealed letters — free from the quest NPC
peacekeeper.note: 400 cycles from a standing start, minus whatever the molars and Catman Alliance already gave you. Bind at one of the two NPCs.
peacekeeper.gain_raw: Merchants of Erudin +5 · High Council of Erudin +5 · High Guard of Erudin +5

bandages.name: Bandages for Honeybugger
bandages.note: Straightforward, and it works even while KoS once you are above level 17.
bandages.gain_raw: Merchants of Rivervale +5 · Guardians of the Vale +5 · Deeppockets +5 · Mayor Gubbin +5

clericsupply.name: Cleric Supplies
clericsupply.item: 400 Black Wolf Skin, 800 Ruined Wolf Pelt, 400 Berries
clericsupply.note: The limiting item is not the one you expect. Roughly 2000 wolf kills for the skins, and the berries are the real wall — three respawn in Misty Thicket on a five-minute timer, six per cycle if you hop between a personal instance and D0, so 5–6 hours for the berries alone even with 200 forage running on cooldown.
clericsupply.gain_raw: Priests of Mischief +5 · Mayor Gubbin +5 · Guardians of the Vale +5

deathfist.name: More Help for Innoruuk
deathfist.note: About 2000 orc kills. Clear the camps in both Commonlands zones, then a personal instance, then a different difficulty between respawns.
deathfist.gain_raw: Dark Ones +5 · Shadowknights of Night Keep +5 · Frogloks of Guk −1

grublocker.name: Nerbilik's Grub Locker
grublocker.zone: Neriak Foreign Quarter → Ocean of Tears
grublocker.item: Grub Lockers — free from The Gobbler
grublocker.note: Bind near Nerbilik and port back for more lockers. Wizard Nek Gate or Druid Ring of Lavastorm, both at 22, turn this from a slog into a loop. The Butcherblock translocator drops you close to him.
grublocker.gain_raw: Da Bashers +10 · Grobb Merchants +5 · Broken Skull Clan −1

ogremuffins.name: Oggok Fresh Baked Muffins
ogremuffins.item: 667 foraged Fruit, baked into 400 Muffins, crated in tens
ogremuffins.note: They must be baked, and Fruit can only be foraged. Expect 70–80 hours of foraging on cooldown even in high-Fruit zones. Get baking to 135 and take the first baking AA so you never fail. Alanna's own advice is to start as an Ogre or wait for another method.
ogremuffins.gain_raw: Merchants of Oggok +5 · Oggok Guards +5 · Clurg +5

kerra.name: Aid the Kerrans of Kerra Isle
kerra.npc: Hail any class GM on the isle
kerra.note: The only race with no +2000 grind at all. Work through every quest on the isle. Most races start at −50 to Kerra Isle faction, but Erudite, Dark Elf, Troll, Ogre and Iksar start at −1000, as do Bertoxxulous, Cazic Thule and Innoruuk worshippers. Killing kobolds in The Warrens now raises it.

DEF.name: Dark Elf
DEF.why: Three factions, one quest, one NPC, one zone, no kills. Nothing else in the game is this contained.

ELF.name: Wood Elf
ELF.why: Two vendor-bought turn-in loops in the same building in West Freeport. Both steps also count toward High Elf, so doing this first makes the next unlock nearly free.

HUMQ.name: Human (Qeynos)
HUMQ.why: Pure vendor work in one city, and Human opens the widest primary class list of any race — thirteen of the sixteen. Also unlocks Half Elf for free.

HIE.name: High Elf
HIE.why: Shares its first two steps with Wood Elf outright — the muffins cover Clerics of Tunare while covering Soldiers of Tunare, and the white wine covers Merchants of Felwithe while covering Kelethin Merchants. If Wood Elf is done, only the bat wings remain.

HEF.name: Half Elf
HEF.city: Freeport · Kelethin · Felwithe · Surefall Glade · Qeynos
HEF.why: No faction work of its own. Unlock Wood Elf or Human (Qeynos) and this one comes with it.

GNM.name: Gnome
GNM.why: The only major unlock that costs no money at all — the quest hands you the items. It is 400 cycles of pure clicking in a single city.

DWF.name: Dwarf
DWF.why: One quest, but you have to brew 400 tonics first. Doing this also produces the tonics Human (Freeport) needs, so run them back to back.

KER.name: Kerran
KER.why: Unlocked by a task chain rather than a faction grind — the only race that works this way. If your race or deity starts you at −1000, raise Kerra Isle faction by killing kobolds in The Warrens first.

HUMF.name: Human (Freeport)
HUMF.why: Far lower volume than most — 110 tonics and 42 notes — but the Militia step needs a night spawn, a mob you have to kill 42 times, and an NPC that wanders the zone. Fiddly rather than long.

BAR.name: Barbarian
BAR.why: The items are free and the turn-ins are quick. Nearly all of the cost is travel between West Karana and Halas, so this one lives or dies on your movement options.

FRG.name: Froglok
FRG.why: A kill grind rather than a shopping trip, but the only one that pays for itself — 400 to 500 high level ghouls is enough experience to carry two classes to 50 along the way.

IKS.name: Iksar
IKS.why: The only race gated behind a single faction rather than three. The catch is money — over 1600 plat of ore unless you farm or recycle the material.

ERU.name: Erudite
ERU.why: Five interlocking steps where several quests actively damage the factions you still need. The one unlock where improvising costs more than following a tested order exactly — do kobolds first, never hand molars in for Heretics faction.

TRL.name: Troll
TRL.why: The grub lockers are free and fast once you can port. The belts are the problem: about 2000 Deathfist orc kills.

HFL.name: Halfling
HFL.why: The bandages are trivial. Cleric Supplies is the wall, and the bottleneck is not the 2000 wolf kills — it is 400 Berries off three respawning nodes on a five-minute timer.

OGR.name: Ogre
OGR.why: Merchants of Oggok has exactly one realistic source, and it needs 667 foraged Fruit — 70 to 80 hours of foraging on cooldown. Alanna's own recommendation is to start as an Ogre or wait for another method to be added.
